Advertisement for recruitment of staff for ICMR-
Center for Advance Research in Reproductive Health
(CAR), SMVDU, Katra
Project Title:-To Restraint or Regulate the Reproductive
Health Issues of Human from Jammu and Kashmir Region
Applications are invited under above referred project for the
following posts purely on temporary & contractual basis:
1. Scientist-‘B’ (Non-Medical)
2. Social Worker
3. Office Assistant
4. Data Entry Operator
5. Multitasking Man
Last Date for submitting the application(s) is 21 days from the
date of publishing of the advertisement.
For details please visit our website: www.smvdu.ac.in
